Elaine K: @channel Quick all-hands reminder — this Wednesday 10:30am PT in Zoom (calendar invite already out). Agenda below, please drop Qs here or add to the doc: https://redwood-internal/ah/1820000123-agenda :calendar:

Elaine K: Agenda (45m):
• 10m — Exec update (growth, hiring, cash)
• 12m — Dedicated GA callouts & rollout plan
• 8m — Incident recap (3/18 region degradation)
• 10m — Policy change brief (rollback / model pinning)
• 5m — Open Q&A / action items

Mike J: Would be great to squeeze a 3–5min demo of the Dedicated rollout UX, can we slot that into the callouts?

Sophia L: I have a one-paragraph postmortem summary for the 3/18 incident. I’ll paste top-line before the meeting and bring details during the incident recap.

Carlos R: Are the policy changes about model pinning public docs or internal? Need guidance for Sales/CS.

Elaine K: Good question — policy doc will be internal first; we’ll publish a customer-facing summary after legal & sales review. I’ll attach the internal note after the meeting.

Andre V: Heads-up: team leads, please nominate 1 question per team to surface during the open mic so we don’t run over.

ExecBot: Reminder scheduled: All-hands Wed 10:00am PT (30m prior). :bell:

--- (post-meeting) ---

Elaine K: Thanks all for joining. Recording: https://recordings.internal/1820000123. Slides deck: https://redwood-internal/ah/decks/1820000123-deck.pdf

Elaine K: TL;DR takeaways:
• Dedicated GA: Launch next Tuesday — reserved capacity onboarding opens for early customers.
• Policy: New rollback policy for model rollouts — immediate auto-rollback on SLA regressions, formal customer-notify window extended to 48hrs.
• Incident (3/18): Root cause = degraded cross-region KV cache during a scaled prefix-eviction. Mitigation: cache throttling + improved failover routing; long-term: redesign cache eviction heuristics.

Mike J: Action items I captured:
• Mike J -> coordinate Dedicated onboarding checklist + sample perms (due EOD Fri)
• Sophia L -> publish short incident topline & link to postmortem (due tomorrow)
• Carlos R -> draft customer-facing policy FAQ & share with Legal (due Mon)

Sophia L: Posting the incident topline here: outage window ~14m, p95 latency spike x3, no customer data exposed. Full postmortem in docs (link in #postmortems).

Carlos R: Will prep the FAQ and ping Legal this afternoon.

Elaine K: If I missed any actions, add below. Thanks for the tight agenda and questions — will follow up with the action tracker.
